// A repository file the model is about to edit. Preserving mode must return it unchanged except
// for the character classes that cannot appear legitimately in source.
using System;

namespace Sample.Gameplay
{
    public sealed class ScoreBoard
    {
        private readonly int[] m_scores = new int[4];

        public int Total()
        {
            var total = 0;
            foreach (var score in m_scores)
            {
                total += score;
            }

            return total;
        }

        // Markdown-looking text that preserving mode must not rewrite:
        // see [the guide](https://docs.example/guides/scores) and run `dotnet build`.
    }
}
